a.title: My CRM
a.class: d-flex gap-2 gap-md-3 py-3 pe-2 px-md-3 h-100 rounded text-decoration-none bg-100

div.t-att-class: 'crm-stage-item crm-stage-active' if default_stage and stage.id == default_stage.id else 'crm-stage-item'

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if sp.id == current_user_id else None
'selected' if current_team_id and tm.id == current_team_id else None
'selected' if comp.id == request.env.company.id else None
'selected' if sp.id == current_user_id else None

div.class: alert alert-danger alert-dismissible fade show mb-3

div.div: Error: Won stage opportunities cannot be converted into Lost.

div.class: alert alert-danger alert-dismissible fade show mb-3

div.div: Error: Please select a reason for marking this opportunity as lost.

form.t-if: lead.type == 'opportunity' and lead.active and not (lead.stage_id and (lead.stage_id.is_won or 'won' in (lead.stage_id.name or '').lower()))

button.t-if: lead.active and not (lead.stage_id and (lead.stage_id.is_won or 'won' in (lead.stage_id.name or '').lower())) and lead.probability != 100.0

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.user_id and lead.user_id.id == sp.id) or (not lead.user_id and sp.id == current_user_id) else None
'selected' if (lead.team_id and lead.team_id.id == tm.id) or (not lead.team_id and current_team_id and tm.id == current_team_id) else None

input.name: company_name_confirm
input.t-att-value: lead.partner_name or (lead.company_partner_id and lead.company_partner_id.name) or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.is_company and lead.partner_id.name) or ''

div.label: Do not link to a customer

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.id == cust.id else None

div.t-if: lead.active and can_edit and not (lead.stage_id and (lead.stage_id.is_won or 'won' in (lead.stage_id.name or '').lower())) and lead.probability != 100.0

input.name: partner_name
input.t-att-value: lead.partner_name or (lead.company_partner_id and lead.company_partner_id.name) or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.name) or ''

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.state_id and lead.state_id.id == st.id) or (not lead.state_id and lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.state_id and lead.partner_id.state_id.id == st.id) else None

input.t-att-value: (lead.state_id and lead.state_id.name) or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.state_id and lead.partner_id.state_id.name) or ''

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.country_id and lead.country_id.id == cntry.id) or (not lead.country_id and lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.country_id and lead.partner_id.country_id.id == cntry.id) else None

input.t-att-value: (lead.country_id and lead.country_id.name) or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.country_id and lead.partner_id.country_id.name) or ''

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.user_id and lead.user_id.id == sp.id) or (not lead.user_id and sp.id == current_user_id) else None
'selected' if (lead.team_id and lead.team_id.id == tm.id) or (not lead.team_id and current_team_id and tm.id == current_team_id) else None

input.t-att-value: lead.team_id.name if lead.team_id else (request.env.user.sale_team_id.name if request.env.user.sale_team_id else '')

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if lead.priority == '0' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '1' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '2' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '3' else None

span.t-if: not can_edit and (not lead or not lead.tag_ids)

div.t-att-class: 'crm-tag-dropdown-item d-none' if (lead and tg.id in lead.tag_ids.ids) else 'crm-tag-dropdown-item'

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if lead.company_id and lead.company_id.id == comp.id else None
'selected' if lead.campaign_id and lead.campaign_id.id == camp.id else None
'selected' if lead.medium_id and lead.medium_id.id == med.id else None
'selected' if lead.source_id and lead.source_id.id == src.id else None
'selected' if not lead.partner_id else None

t.t-if: lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.id not in [c.id for c in all_customers]

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.id == cust.id else None

input.name: contact_name
input.t-att-value: lead.contact_name or lead.partner_name or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.name) or ''

input.name: partner_name
input.t-att-value: lead.partner_name or (lead.company_partner_id and lead.company_partner_id.name) or (lead.partner_id and lead.partner_id.name) or ''

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.user_id and lead.user_id.id == sp.id) or (not lead.user_id and sp.id == current_user_id) else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '0' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '1' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '2' else None
'selected' if lead.priority == '3' else None

span.t-if: not can_edit and (not lead or not lead.tag_ids)

div.t-att-class: 'crm-tag-dropdown-item d-none' if (lead and tg.id in lead.tag_ids.ids) else 'crm-tag-dropdown-item'

option.t-att-selected: 'selected' if (lead.state_id and lead.state_id.id == st.id) or (partner and partner.state_id and partner.state_id.id == st.id) else None
'selected' if (lead.country_id and lead.country_id.id == cntry.id) or (partner and partner.country_id and partner.country_id.id == cntry.id) else None
'selected' if (lead.user_id and lead.user_id.id == sp.id) or (not lead.user_id and sp.id == current_user_id) else None

input.t-att-value: lead.team_id and lead.team_id.name or (request.env.user.sale_team_id.name if getattr(request.env.user, 'sale_team_id', False) else '')
